description: Use this to see the deterministic rules on one inbox, in the order they run. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. Input: inbox_id (required; inbox id, username, or email). Returns {object:"list", data:[inbox_rule]}. Each rule has id, name, enabled, position, conditions, actions, stop_processing, match_count, last_matched_at, last_error, client_id, created_at, and updated_at. An inbox-scoped key for another inbox returns HTTP 404 inbox_not_found.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

name: cooper_list_rules
title: List inbox rules
